remarks: ALL OFFERS TO BE RECEIVED BY NOON (12:00) ON FRIDAY THE 15TH. An open floor plan with abundant windows and doors fills the home with natural light and creates seamless access to a terrace and expansive, level backyard. Featuring a spacious primary suite, generous secondary bedrooms, an updated kitchen, new 5-zone heating system, and a detached three-car garage-perfect for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.
